headline: FSD v14.3.5 begins rolling out (build 2026.20.6.6) — camera preview now accessible at any time (not just during active FSD engagement); Tesla app now shows live FSD active status indicator while driving; concurrent v14.3.4 (2026.14.6.12) received mixed user reception per TeslaOracle; basenor confirmed rollout started July 13 morning; incremental UX improvements confirm Tesla maintaining aggressive FSD software cadence heading into the pivotal Jul 22 Q2 earnings report (basenor / TeslaOracle, Jul 13, 2026)

Tesla Q2 earnings setup 'just changed' — Seeking Alpha notes 480K delivery beat (18% above consensus) has forced analysts to raise EPS and revenue forecasts ahead of Jul 22; Motley Fool forecasts post-earnings gain if margins show expansion alongside volume; SpaceX IPO spotlight cited as new headwind — investors now have two Musk vehicles competing for allocation; TSLA trading ~$407 (Jul 12 range: $402–$413); pre-earnings analyst consensus shifting bullish 9 days before the print (Seeking Alpha / Motley Fool / Yahoo Finance, Jul 13, 2026)

Tesla confirms Cybercab employee rides 'starting soon' at Giga Texas — official Tesla Robotaxi account posted video of production Cybercab (no steering wheel, no pedals) autonomously picking up and dropping off employees in the Giga Texas outbound lot; basenor: 'Tesla has quietly crossed a line that no major automaker has crossed before'; Electrek notes ambiguity on whether operations are parking-lot-only or public roads; original post included Robotaxi app vent-control UI clip (later edited out — sparking speculation about app feature depth); first time purpose-built Level 4 hardware has transported employees at commercial-adjacent scale (notateslaapp / basenor / Electrek / Mashable, Jul 11, 2026)

Tesla files new Model Y Performance with China MIIT — dual-motor AWD, 250 km/h top speed, 21-inch wheels; repositions as premium performance SUV to defend against BYD and fast-growing Chinese rivals (Leapmotor, Nio, XPeng); BYD H1 2026 total NEV sales fell 15.7% YoY while Tesla gained 25% YoY in Q2 — trajectories crossing; Tesla's China-first premium strategy targets the performance/tech segment rather than price-competing with mass-market domestic brands; TSLA slipped ~2% overnight Sunday as investors weighed execution risk (eletric-vehicles.com / Stocktwits / TradingView, Jul 11–12, 2026)

Tesla Austin Robotaxi Hub confirmed with autonomous cleaning robot — Texas state building permit (filed Jun 2025, closed Mar 2026) reveals first-ever automated cleaning robot deployed at Tesla's 5900 E Ben White Blvd Austin robotaxi hub alongside V4 Superchargers and an equipment inspection system; crews this week removed boundary fences and tarps, signaling the hub is entering active operations; fully autonomous cleaning infrastructure eliminates the human labor bottleneck for scaling a 24/7 Cybercab commercial fleet; no other robotaxi operator (Waymo, Zoox) has publicly disclosed autonomous vehicle cleaning at commercial hubs; operational cleaning robot confirms Tesla is engineering end-to-end automation of the robotaxi supply chain — from vehicle production to fleet maintenance — ahead of Cybercab commercial scale (notateslaapp / Teslarati / WindowsNews, Jul 11–12, 2026)

Musk mandates Grok 4.5 at Tesla; caps rival AI tools at $200/week per employee — Elon Musk directed all Tesla staff to adopt xAI's Grok 4.5 wherever possible and imposed a $200/week per-employee spending cap on third-party AI tools (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google); Grok 4.5 costs ~$0.13/task vs ~$1.57 for alternatives — a 12x cost advantage; plans confirmed for Grok 4.5 integration into Tesla vehicles by fall 2026; deepens xAI-Tesla operational integration and channels compute spend to xAI, cutting AI opex significantly ahead of Q2 earnings Jul 22 (The Information / Electrek / CryptoBriefing, Jul 10–11, 2026)

Tesla Model Y L US order books open; first deliveries slip to October–November 2026 — Tesla officially began accepting US orders for Model Y L (long wheelbase, 3-row) on July 11; Launch Series AWD priced at $61,990 with $250 non-refundable deposit; base AWD $41,990; first US deliveries now set for October–November per Forbes tracking, later than the 'summer 2026' window initially implied at launch; 3-row configuration directly targets Rivian R1S ($75,900), Kia EV9 ($55,900), and Hyundai Ioniq 9; bundled 1-year free FSD + Supercharging + Premium Connectivity retain as part of Launch Series (TeslaOracle / Forbes / AutoBuyersGuide, Jul 11–12, 2026)

Citizens analyst Andrew Boone initiates TSLA at Market Perform — warns 2027/2028 revenue will land 4% and 12% below consensus, respectively, citing slower-than-expected Optimus and robotaxi ramp timelines; Boone flagged that Tesla's 'grand vision will take time to achieve' and that the vision-only FSD stack carries elevated accident risk vs. sensor-fusion peers; bearish initiation adds a notable Wall Street skeptic heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings; TSLA slipped overnight on the note, trading in the $402–$412 range Jul 10 (Citizens JMP / GuruFocus / BigGo Finance / Stocktwits, Jul 9–10, 2026)

EXCLUSIVE: Production Cybercabs ship with DUAL GPS — redundant positioning system (two independent GPS receivers) added for high-precision location tracking; no consumer Tesla has shipped with dual GPS; Level 4 self-certification requires navigation redundancy and the dual-GPS design directly satisfies that requirement; combined with the previously confirmed enhanced FSD computer (>32GB RAM), Cybercab is now confirmed to have at least three hardware differentiators vs consumer Model 3/Y: dual GPS, stronger FSD compute, and 48V architecture (notateslaapp, Jul 9–10, 2026)

SpaceX IPO prices at $135/share raising ~$85B at $1.77T valuation — largest IPO in history; JPMorgan (analyst Rajat Gupta) immediately publishes note calling Tesla-SpaceX merger 'strategically coherent,' citing deep operational integration already in place across AI, robotics, energy, and transport; SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell also floated the idea publicly; governance hurdle remains: Musk controls ~85% of SPCX voting power vs only ~20% of TSLA voting power; Bloomberg reports TSLA stock has held its ground in the month since the IPO (CNBC / Benzinga / Bloomberg, Jul 8–10, 2026)
